grounding.states: Lionel Messi is the pick for soccer's GOAT, and the most recent coverage leans his way
grounding.from: Most recent coverage leans toward Lionel Messi as the GOAT.

grounding.states: Messi's 2026 World Cup performance strengthened the case for him
grounding.from: The Korea Times (July 13, 2026) said Messi's performances in Qatar and at the 2026 World Cup have strengthened the view that he has edged ahead in the GOAT debate.

grounding.states: Tom Brady is still widely treated as the NFL GOAT
grounding.from: Tom Brady is still widely treated as the NFL GOAT.

grounding.states: Patrick Mahomes is the main challenger to Brady, and fans remain divided
grounding.from: Patrick Mahomes is the main challenger. Fans remain divided.

value.answer: Messi, if you mean soccer. Most people who weigh it lean his way, and his 2026 World Cup strengthened the case. If you mean the NFL, I'd still go with Tom Brady, though Mahomes is closing in and fans are split on it.
